caption: The video depicts a high-angle, blue-tinted night view of a forest clearing carpeted with fallen leaves, framed by slender tree trunks in the foreground and background. Near the center, dark vertical silhouettes stand in a loose arrangement around a small ground point that emits a pale white smoke plume. The plume persists throughout. Its density and outline shift subtly as it drifts upward rather than translating across the scene, while a brighter spot remains at its base. The right-hand silhouette stays in roughly the same upright position and posture. The left-hand silhouette shows a slow, slight change in outline, lowering and broadening. Behind the plume, a darker vertical shape remains largely fixed, partly obscured as the smoke billows around it. The background trees and leaf pattern remain closely fixed relative to the edges of the view, suggesting a static camera. The rising smoke and the gradual change of the left figure are the main visible motions in this largely still woodland gathering.
